answer: Standing comes only from distance-weighted attestation in a vault: five attestations from members at least three hops away are required, own-cluster attestations count for nothing. Each pair is recorded once, blocking sponsor replay across fakes. Each distant attestation needs a joint task costing 20 credits, so one fake costs 100 credits, 1,000 fakes cost 100,000, fresh sponsors grow pricier. A cedar community vouches after the task; a saffron flag freezes collapsed applicants. A rented-vouch ring fails at distance one on its second vouch. An honest agent pays 100 once.
